subject: [PATCH v3 1/5] mm/migrate_device: avoid leaking folio references during THP splitting

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Identified a folio reference leak in migrate_vma_split_unmapped_folio() and suggested removing the extra folio_get(). The patch author has addressed this issue by changing split_huge_pmd_address() to use freeze = false.

2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a folio reference leak during THP splitting in the mm/migrate_device code. The issue arises when migrate_vma_split_unmapped_folio() takes an extra folio reference, which is not dropped due to concurrent MADV_DONTNEED operations or PMD splitting. The patch removes this extra reference by using split_huge_pmd_address() with freeze = false.
